description: Add, remove, enable, or disable a WireGuard interface. Idempotent by name. RouterOS generates the private key on create — it is never passed in. The public key is returned after creation.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

listenPort.description: UDP listen port (RouterOS picks one if omitted)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_wireguard_interface
title: Manage WireGuard Interface
